# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 23, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on Aug 23, 2026, focused heavily on system stability, data integrity, and comprehensive test coverage. Key achievements include implementing robust NaN handling across sorting comparators to ensure deterministic behavior, enhancing Unicode safety with surrogate-safe truncation, and significantly expanding the unit test suite across the core, agent, and cloud packages.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Deterministic Sorting and Data Integrity
*   Implemented `Number.isFinite` guards across numerous sort comparators in `core`, `agent`, and various plugins to prevent `NaN` values from causing non-deterministic sorting behavior ([#25970](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25970), [#25949](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25949), [#25931](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25931), [#25913](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25913)).
*   Enforced strict canonical integer parsing to reject whitespace-padded inputs, improving data validation robustness ([#25843](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25843)).

### Unicode and String Safety
*   Standardized string truncation using `truncateWellFormed` and `toWellFormedUnicode` across multiple services to prevent malformed Unicode and lone surrogate pairs in logs, error messages, and UI previews ([#25922](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25922), [#25915](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25915), [#25844](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25844)).

### Cloud and Agent Infrastructure
*   Enhanced cloud stability by implementing durable sandbox replacement attempts ([#25721](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25721)) and improving voice runtime warmups to reduce latency ([#26657](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26657)).
*   Bootstrapped the production controller for synthetic worlds using a journal-backed approach ([#25407](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/25407)).

### Testing and Documentation
*   Massive expansion of unit test coverage, adding colocated Vitest suites for dozens of previously untested modules across `agent`, `core`, `cloud`, and `app-core` packages to ensure system reliability ([#26265](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26265), [#26264](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26264), [#26263](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26263)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A large volume of pull requests were opened, primarily focused on pinning test coverage and hardening system components. Notable PRs include:
*   [#26721](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26721): Pin extra settings-group registry.
*   [#26720](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26720): Remove hardcoded model output ceilings.
*   [#26702](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26702): Match stateless indicators on word boundaries.
*   [#26683](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26683): Redact camelCase sensitive keys in settings debug dumps.
*   [#26673](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26673): Remove lossy model context compression.
